question: Which sector runs nearly 60 percent of dispensaries in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Private Sector.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• **The private sector runs nearly 60 percent of dispensaries in India.**
 
• Private dispensaries are owned and operated by** private individuals or organizations.**
 
• The cooperative sector refers to dispensaries run by cooperatives, which are** owned and operated by a group of individuals for their mutual benefit.**
 
• The joint sector refers to dispensaries run jointly by the** government and private individuals or organizations.**
 
• The public sector refers to** dispensaries run by the government.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The private sector has been playing a significant role in providing healthcare services in India, especially in urban areas.
 
• The cooperative sector has a limited presence in the healthcare sector in India.
 
• The joint sector has been encouraged by the government to improve healthcare infrastructure in the country.
 
• The public sector has the largest number of dispensaries in India but often faces challenges in providing quality healthcare services due to lack of resources and infrastructure.
